svg.title: Figure 1 · The process maps
svg.desc: Every draw.io process map with its lanes, steps and export
svg.text: 6 draw.io maps, read from the sources: each map's lanes left to right with the steps under each, whether its SVG export still carries every label of its source (6 of 6 do),
and the pages that show it.
Analyses inform each other; the arrows are information flow, not mandatory sequencing.
Residual risk acceptance is a separate authorized decision, never automatic closure.
Every handoff requires an owner, configuration ID and evidence links.
Iterative lifecycle: every configuration change can reopen hazard analysis.
PX4 flight-control software and walker control software remain distinct assurance boundaries.
Failed tests or changed configurations trigger reanalysis and re-verification.
SVG export carries every source label
Export out of step with its source

Generated by tools/figures/diagrams_readme.py from the draw.io sources, their SVG exports and the MIL-STD-882E tailoring. The maps are illustrative draft workflows, not normative flowcharts or evidence of completed tasks.

g.text: Terms: ARP4754B = SAE guidelines for development of civil aircraft and systems · ARP4761A = SAE guidelines for the safety assessment process on civil aircraft · CONOPS = concept of operations · DoD = US

Department of Defense · EHA = environmental hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 210) · FHA = functional hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 208; also ARP4761A aircraft FHA) · HHA = health hazard analysis

(MIL-STD-882E Task 207) · ID = identifier · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · PHA = preliminary hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 202) · PHL = preliminary

hazard list (MIL-STD-882E Task 201) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SAE = SAE International, publisher of ARP4754B and ARP4761A · SHA = system hazard analysis

(MIL-STD-882E Task 205) · SRHA = system requirements hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 203) · SSHA = subsystem hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 204) · SSPP = system safety program plan (MIL-STD-882E Task 102)
· SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SVG = Scalable Vector Graphics, the figure file format · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
